body_lead: Amaravati, May 15 (APAC Media): The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet has approved investment proposals worth more than Rs 1.4 lakh crore across sectors, including artificial intelligence, clean energy, manufacturing, infrastructure, and food processing. The decisions were taken during the 49th Cabinet meeting chaired by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu at the Secretariat. A major highlight of the approvals was the clearance granted to Reliance Industries Limited for establishing a giga-scale AI data centre project in the Visakhapatnam district.
